notes.title: Bug fixes and improvements! #02
notes.notes:
Hello, intergalactic travelers!

We are LOVING the community feedback on Isolated Room and have plans for MANY improvements to the game in the very near future! Today we have made a series of small improvements and bug fixes.

Bug Fixes:
- Text sound was not being adjusted by the game volume setting.
- Vertical Pursuit: Game music was also not being adjusted.
- Vertical Pursuit: There was a small chance of two cars spawning on top of each other.
- Vertical Pursuit: Variables are now reset correctly when restarting the game by turning off the TV.

Other Changes:
- More clarity to indicate when the player wants to work if anxious.
- The color of the text "anxious" was orange instead of red in some moments.
- Correction in the options that appear when trying to sleep at night.
- Language selection screen now only appears when starting the game.
- Daytime shift change messages should only appear if the player is in the room view.

Stay tuned to our social media channels (Twitter or Instagram) to keep up with everything we have planned!

More updates coming soon! ✌️✨
Black Hole Games

notes.title: Post-launch hotfix!
notes.notes:
Hello, intergalactic travelers!

We would like to thank everyone who is playing our game on launch! We have received a lot of positive feedback and we are working to make your experience even better!

Today, we are releasing a small hotfix to fix some issues that were noticed during playtesting. These include:

• Vertical Pursuit:
- Fixing car collision boxes.
- Music no longer restarts after the boss, but continues from where it left off.
- Boss appearance time adjusted.
- Police car attacks are now gradually faster with each attack.
- New car pattern implemented: two cars can appear together after beating the boss the first time.

• Other changes:
- Greater clarity on the trigger for the secret achievement. 🤫
- Interaction with Asleep Poster implemented during the Afternoon and Night shifts. 🔦

We hope these fixes improve your gaming experience and we thank you again for all the support. We would like to take this opportunity to invite you to join our community on Discord!
Keep playing and let us know if you have any problems or suggestions!

Thanks, and have fun! :D
Black Hole Games
